title: Sony FX6 Full-Frame Cinema Workhorse Camera (ILME-FX6)
purpose: Versatile run-and-gun documentary and commercial full-frame cinema camera pairing a 10.2MP Exmor R sensor, Dual Base ISO 800/12800, and 15+ stops dynamic range with built-in stepless Electronic Variable ND filtration.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Sony FX6 Full-Frame Cinema Line Workhorse (ILME-FX6)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.6 x 23.8mm Full-Frame Back-Illuminated Exmor R CMOS sensor (10.2MP effective cinema readout, 15+ stops S-Log3 latitude)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 35mm native full-frame field of view (E-mount with 12G-SDI cinema I/O)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Sony FE 24-70mm F2.8 GM II (SEL2470GM2) at 50mm f/2.8
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Dual Base ISO 800 / 12800 with integrated Electronic Variable ND (1/4 to 1/128)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15+ stops dynamic range in S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine and S-Cinetone with 16-bit RAW SDI output capability
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 180-degree cinema shutter angle (1/48s cadence) maintained under bright daylight via internal Variable ND

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Bright outdoor sunlight balanced at wide-open f/2.8 via built-in Electronic Variable ND filter alongside soft muslin bounce or negative fill
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Controlled wide-aperture daylight highlight roll-off preventing blown highlights while preserving natural midtone skin nuance

surface_rendering: True documentary cinema acutance resolving natural skin relief, fabric grain, and crisp foliage without artificial clarity
Consistent S-Cinetone / VENICE color science across bright exterior and interior transitions
Clean low-noise shadow retention even in fast available-light documentary setups
depth_and_optics: Shallow wide-aperture f/2.0–f/2.8 depth in bright sun made physically possible by stepless Electronic Variable ND
Smooth G-Master II focus falloff with zero computational edge haloing

execution_directive: Enforce Sony FX6 (ILME-FX6) full-frame 10.2MP Exmor R documentary cinema capture with Electronic Variable ND wide-aperture daylight control, Dual Base ISO 800/12800 cleanliness, and 15+ stops S-Cinetone roll-off.
